note: heiban godan verb (Wiktionary: Heiban [0]) stays heiban in negative — real rendered romaji [kàwánáí], no downstep mark
ば induces its own downstep right before itself on an otherwise-heiban verb — real rendered romaji [kàéꜜbà], drop after mora 2 (え), not flat
なかった gets a downstep a fixed 3 morae from the end even for a heiban verb — real rendered romaji [kàwánáꜜkàttà], drop after mora 3 (な), not flat
ない always attaches with its own atamadaka accent, landing right before it — real rendered romaji [hàshíráꜜnàì], drop after mora 3 (ら), one mora past the citation stem boundary (mora 2)
an already-accented verb's ba-form keeps the same absolute mora index as citation — real rendered romaji [hàshíꜜrèbà], drop after mora 2 (し)
なかった carries the negative form's own (already-shifted) downstep straight through — real rendered romaji [hàshíráꜜnàkàttà], drop after mora 3 (ら)
